newsitem.title: UK: UK's First Leisure makes management changes.
newsitem.headline: UK's First Leisure makes management changes.

text.p: Britain's First Leisure Corp Plc said on Monday it had made a number of management changes to coincide with Michael Grade's new position as chief executive.
The company said director Mike Payne, previously responsible for First Leisure's nightclubs and tenpin bowling businesses, was named managing director, operations, effective immediately.
The company said finance director Graham Coles would assume board responsibility for corporate property and related development functions.
Nick Tamblyn, formerly executive director in charge of bingo, health and fitness and commercial development, left the company following the reshuffle, First Leisure said in a statement.
Grade, previously chief executive at television company Channel Four, took up his post as chief executive on Monday. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
